comparison_tools.streaming_contract: full source hashes, complete receipts, stop barriers, and ordinal no-resync comparison

low_volume_mame.record_storage: one closed JSON file per record
low_volume_mame.merge: post-exit only; malformed or missing records fail closed

vblank_irq_cadence.default: duplicate level-3 handler entries per VBlank interval are fatal
vblank_irq_cadence.opt_in_contract: after the first post-reset VBlank, exactly one handler entry per completed VBlank interval
vblank_irq_cadence.scope_note: the exact-one contract is scenario-qualified because some sets can still be in boot/reset at the first post-epoch raster interval

anchors.reset_release: first completed observation after the core/reference reset interval ends
anchors.first_fetch: first completed V60 program-ROM fetch after reset release
anchors.first_retirement: MAME device_debug instruction_hook and RTL V60 S_DECODE architectural boundary, both sampled before execution; focused phase equivalence proven
anchors.irq: accepted V60 external interrupt acknowledge with requested/enabled/vector context
anchors.vblank: native raster entry to vertical blank
anchors.frame_complete: completed native unrotated surface at the producer frame boundary; stop budget begins after the accepted $21000e bit-7 video-enable epoch
anchors.native_rgb_crc: CRC32 over the completed native 336x240 RGB surface; comparable only within a declared frame window with no resynchronization
anchors.state_crc: per-frame CRCs of list512, spr8k, scroll63 and pal512 memory ranges at the native frame boundary; diagnostic candidate
anchors.input_consumption: raw board-input journal frame ordinal applied before the corresponding native frame; MAME frontend coin impulse is disabled with -coin_impulse -1

cpu_data.promotion_gate: two byte-identical cold captures per producer with identical scenario journal and no device-1 program-ROM fetches
cpu_data.bounded_projection: tools/project_ssv_strict_window.py copies source events for a declared native-frame interval and emits a provenance-bound receipt; it never resynchronizes or rewrites event fields
cpu_data.normalization: cpu_data_lane_mask_v1: mask data with active-high byte_enable before ordinal comparison (BE1=0x00ff, BE2=0xff00, BE3=0xffff); source traces remain unchanged
cpu_data.strict_only_profile: optional producer output profile strict_only=true emits only canonical mainbus fields; it preserves the real harness, journal, barriers and receipt semantics
cpu_data.meaning: strict projection of completed 16-bit CPU data transactions for devices 0 and 2-11; program-ROM instruction fetches are excluded because MAME tap granularity differs from RTL 64-bit fills

mame.source: tools/mame-ssv-headless.lua full program-space tap projected by tools/compare_ssv_strict.py
mame.evidence: MAME 0.289 program-space callback emits completed 16-bit data-lane events; device 1 is excluded from the strict projection

rtl.source: ssv_core debug_mainbus_* ports consumed by verif/ssv_diff_probe.sv
rtl.evidence: ssv_core debug_mainbus_complete is a completed 16-bit CPU transaction; device 1 is excluded from the strict projection

mainbus.promotion_gate: diagnostic only; use cpu_data for strict acceptance
mainbus.meaning: one completed 16-bit V60 program-space transaction, including ROM data, work RAM and every decoded or unmapped device cycle

mame.evidence: MAME 0.289 (mame0289) program-space tap callback after access

rtl.source: ssv_core debug_mainbus_* ports consumed by verif/ssv_diff_probe.sv
rtl.evidence: m_req && ack_r && !ack_r_d with stable read_mux/write data

mainbus.known_sampling_question: FAST_IFETCH wide instruction fills are diagnostic v60_ifetch events until MAME opcode-fetch granularity is proven equivalent

v60_ifetch.reason_diagnostic: MAME program tap access width/granularity differs

v60_retire.meaning: MAME device_debug instruction hook and RTL S_DECODE boundary before execution, with PC/opcode/PSW and all GPRs
v60_retire.reason_diagnostic: focused phase equivalence is proven for 753 boundaries; two corrected cold full-scenario captures remain required before promotion

v60_irq_entry.meaning: MAME debugger-trace marker for a configured V60 IRQ handler PC before handler execution
v60_irq_entry.reason_diagnostic: diagnostic cadence anchor; not a PCB-cycle equivalent by itself

irq.meaning: request/mask state changes and accepted V60 acknowledge/vector events
irq.reason_diagnostic: MAME callback phase requires same-side proof

st010.meaning: DSP retirement, host access and program-fetch request/completion
st010.reason_diagnostic: MAME uPD96050 sampling phase requires proof

es5506.meaning: host commit, IRQ promotion, sample request/completion/tick and underrun
es5506.reason_diagnostic: MAME voice-writeback/sample scheduling is not a bus-level equivalent

video.meaning: video enable, native scanline/frame boundaries and renderer ownership violations
video.reason_diagnostic: native boundary semantics must be proven before pixel comparison

native_rgb_crc.meaning: CRC32 of the native unrotated 336x240 RGB frame
native_rgb_crc.promotion_gate: declared frame window, matching frame cursor, no resynchronization, and two cold captures per producer

state_crc.meaning: per-frame CRCs for list512, spr8k, scroll63 and pal512
state_crc.reason_diagnostic: frame callback memory sampling is not PCB-cycle equivalence; all fields must match before promotion
